ui.provider-link.authorize-hint: This opens the authorization page of {0} in your browser. After you authorize, come back to Nomi to confirm. The key never appears in a link.
ui.provider-link.connect-hint: If a third-party provider supports Nomi web authorization, sign in and authorize on its site to add it — no key to copy
ui.provider-link.connect-message: Enter the third-party provider's site (for example example.com). Nomi opens its authorization page in your browser.
ui.provider-link.connect-title: Add a third-party provider by web authorization
ui.provider-link.err-bad-issuer: The authorization site must be an https domain, not this computer or the local network.
ui.provider-link.err-bad-key: The key is missing or malformed.
ui.provider-link.err-bad-link: The link is malformed or uses an unsupported version.
ui.provider-link.err-bad-manifest: This site doesn't provide a valid Nomi authorization manifest (/.well-known/nomi-provider.json).
ui.provider-link.err-bad-name: The third-party provider name is missing.
ui.provider-link.err-bad-payload: The third-party provider details in the link can't be read.
ui.provider-link.err-bad-state: This authorization expired or was already used. Please start again.
ui.provider-link.err-bad-token: Authorization finished, but no valid key was returned.
ui.provider-link.err-bad-url: Endpoints must use https and can't point to this computer or the local network (add those manually in Settings).
ui.provider-link.err-denied: You canceled the authorization on the website.
ui.provider-link.err-network: Couldn't reach the authorization site. Check your network and try again.
ui.provider-link.source-link: Web link (the originating site can't be verified)
ui.provider-link.trust-hint: Only add third-party providers you trust: requests sent through it include your conversation content.
ui.provider-link.update-hint: A third-party provider with the same endpoint already exists. Confirming adds this key and any missing endpoints and models to it instead of creating a new one.
